summary: A minor pivot can deliver massive relief the exact second you stop trying to resuscitate an old routine that has simply aged out.
body: A minor pivot can deliver massive relief the exact second you stop trying to resuscitate an old routine that has simply aged out. When the Moon sextiles Uranus, emotional flexibility makes experimentation frictionless, allowing you to tweak a habit or expectation without launching a full-scale life crisis. Sometimes the liberation you've been starving for is just the permission to alter one single variable. Make the small change and watch how much pressure instantly drops.
